memoryReview.lesson: Horizontal waveform and flowing staff replace the fixed file-operation rail and byte ledger.
Mint signal strip and compact measure sequence replace the warm composition folio.
Broad waveform with notation below replaces cobalt rehearsal station panels.

references.observation: YIN modifies autocorrelation to reduce fundamental frequency estimation errors.
references.principle: Represent pitch uncertainty instead of promising flawless transcription from raw recordings.
references.application: Normalized difference pitch estimator with confidence coloring and a waveform.
references.avoid: Do not claim full research implementation or neural source separation.

references.observation: Basic Pitch is instrument-agnostic and supports polyphonic transcription.
references.principle: Note transcription is distinct from instrument identity and source separation.
references.application: Clearly label the spectral register mode as approximate and not vocal separation.
references.avoid: Do not claim the Basic Pitch neural model is installed or running.

references.observation: MusicXML describes notation using measures, pitch, duration and time signatures.
references.principle: Encode durations and rests explicitly rather than exporting only note names.
references.application: A four-division beat grid emits measures and ties in separately named parts.
references.avoid: Do not assume a manual tempo recovers a recording's precise meter.

concepts.medium: Native audio APIs, worker signal analysis and editable vector notation.
concepts.composition: One horizontal recording strip over a responsive continuous staff.
concepts.interaction: Import, transcribe, compare, correct and export actual events.
concepts.motion: Waveform appears on decoded audio; pitches highlight in time.
concepts.rationale: Chosen because measured audio and readable notation stay connected.

concepts.medium: Full-screen canvas sequencer and piano key grid.
concepts.composition: Vertical keyboard beside zoomable temporal note matrix.
concepts.interaction: Draw and stretch rectangular note blocks on a timeline.
concepts.motion: Panning and inertial zoom follow horizontal audio sequences.
concepts.rationale: Rejected because a piano roll de-emphasizes the printable sheet.

concepts.medium: Circular dial with live frequency rings and radial vector markings.
concepts.composition: Centered tuning instrument with controls around its circumference.
concepts.interaction: Watch a live pitch and manually capture individual notes.
concepts.motion: Rotating needle follows fundamental frequency with damped motion.
concepts.rationale: Rejected because manual live capture does not handle full recordings well.

selection.reason: Actual waveform and printable notation create a clear transformation with direct editing.

rejected.reason: Sequencer navigation adds complexity and de-emphasizes the printed score.
Tuner focuses on one moment and cannot present a complete composition.

tools.reason: Native vector paths and semantic controls are lightweight and local.
Sound Forge draft explicitly lacks production runtime integration.
tools.fallback: Use local Web Audio and export standard MIDI for interchange.

assets.role: Waveform turning into two beamed notes identifies the application.
assets.acceptance: Waveform and two noteheads remain recognizable on a 48px tile.
assets.integration: Same original vector appears in manifest and recorder identity.
assets.provenance: Self-authored vector paths and ellipses created for Notograph.

risks: Verify notation glyphs on mobile Safari and print layout.
Verify playback gesture and microphone permissions.
Confirm register mode does not imply stem isolation.
comparisons: Compare input strip and notation against Press rail.
Compare audio-first workflow against Folkarium composition surface.
